title: GPU-Aware Dense Tensors for R
text: Explicit cpu, cuda, auto device selection. Dense vectors, matrices, arrays cudatensor S3 class. CPU/GPU transfer. Natural element-wise arithmetic safe dtype promotion. Matrix multiplication. Sum mean reductions one-based R dimensions. NumPy-style trailing-dimension broadcasting. Standard R subsetting replacement, reshape, transpose, matrix conversion. Portable base R backend development CI. Optional CUDA execution CUDA-enabled torch installation.

title: GPU-Aware Dense Tensors for R
GPU-Aware Dense Tensors for R
text: Subsetting always returns cudatensor, including single selected value. Replacement preserves original dtype, assigning fractional value integer tensor fails instead silently truncating . current release, subsetting CUDA tensor uses CPU round trip; matrix arithmetic, broadcasting, reductions, reshape, transpose remain device-native. Use device = "cuda" require GPU execution:
code: library(cudatensr)  x <- cuda_tensor(matrix(1:6, 2, 3)) y <- cuda_tensor(matrix(1:6, 3, 2))  tensor_device(x) to_cpu(tensor_matmul(x, y)) to_cpu(x + 0.5) to_cpu(tensor_mean(x, dim = 1))  reshaped <- tensor_reshape(cuda_tensor(1:12), c(3, 4)) reshaped[1:2, 2:4, drop = FALSE] t(reshaped) if (cuda_available()) {   x_gpu <- cuda_tensor(matrix(rnorm(1e6), 1000), device = "cuda") }

title: GPU-Aware Dense Tensors for R
text: device = "auto" selects CUDA optional torch package reports usable CUDA backend; otherwise selects base R CPU backend. object always reports actual device backend tensor_device(). Printing tensors 100 values shows metadata without copying large CUDA allocation back R. Use to_cpu(x) intentionally want complete base R array, change display threshold options(cudatensr.max_print = 500). initial release API correctness milestone, yet claim speedups every workload. installation, device verification, memory advice, common failures, see cudaverse GPU setup troubleshooting guide.

title: cudatensr 0.1.1
text: Added standard R subsetting replacement methods, tensor_reshape(), t(), .matrix() tensors can manipulated without reaching internal storage. Printing large tensor now reports metadata without implicitly materializing entire object CPU. display threshold controlled options(cudatensr.max_print = 100). Added natural element-wise tensor arithmetic %*% dispatch trailing-dimension broadcasting. Added explicit mixed-dtype promotion. Integer arithmetic, reductions, matrix products now promote safely instead truncating fractions silently overflowing NA. Lossy explicit conversion integer dtype now fails clearly.
